source_name: Microsoft and LinkedIn Work Trend Index 2024
definition: Percentage of knowledge workers reporting use of generative artificial intelligence (AI) for work; survey question: “How often do you use generative artificial intelligence (AI) for your work?”
methodology: Microsoft Work Trend Index survey conducted by Edelman Data & Intelligence online from February 15 to March 28, 2024 among 31,000 full-time employed or self-employed knowledge workers across 31 markets; 1,000 full-time workers per market. The U.S. also had an additional sample of 2,800 workers across nine sub-regions/metros. The reported country values use the same workplace GenAI-use question and knowledge-worker population.
notes: Microsoft India release reports 92% of Indian knowledge workers use AI at work; this WTI measure is specific to knowledge workers, not the entire workforce.
